Most generalist contractors skip the "invisible" science because it takes specialized tools and professional training. They want to get the floor down and get out of your house. Fall Rain and Winter Frost Can Put Pressure on Basement Walls Saturated soil gets heavier, and when it freezes it expands. In Maine, wet fall weather followed by hard freezes can push against basement walls that are already under stress. Take a few minutes to look for a horizontal crack near the middle of a wall, a wall that leans or curves inward, stair-step cracks in block, or new gaps where the wall meets the floor or ceiling.
